# SCI-MAP v0.1 r0.6 Shared-Authority Parity

The formal contract and Engineering Conformance Specification import the same
compatibility wrapper and the same six common modules in fixed order:
`notation`, `definitions`, `equations`, `assumptions`, `requirements`, and
`edge_cases`. The science-team rationale imports the same notation,
definitions, equations, and assumptions and provides a concise grouped route
to the canonical requirements/predictions rather than duplicating them.

Automated checks require 52 unique contiguous requirement IDs and 25 unique
contiguous prediction IDs in both formal and ECS rendered text, nine stable
owner-decision IDs with eight open, current profile/boundary identities, and
absence of the repaired stale terms. The source manifest records the
byte-ordered shared-authority digest. No audience view may redefine a common
equation, gate, exposure population, response role, or coadd policy.
